haushalt.beschluss.gesetz: Budget law {jahr}: {posten} {richtung} (about {mrd} bn lira a year).
haushalt.beschluss.nachtrag: Supplementary budget: {posten} {richtung} (about {mrd} bn lira a year).
haushalt.beschluss.nachtrag_kosten: Supplement outside the window: {kosten} capital (double) and a legitimacy penalty.
haushalt.fehler.gleich: The item is already at this level.
haushalt.fehler.im_fenster: In October the budget runs through the draft: set the sliders here for free and introduce them as a budget law.
haushalt.fehler.im_fenster_warum: The budget window bundles all changes into one parliamentary act.
haushalt.fehler.im_parlament: The draft budget is already in parliament: let it be voted on first, then change it.
haushalt.fehler.unbekannt: This budget item does not exist.
haushalt.posten.bildung.kehrseite: Education pays off only after years; training people without jobs in research and industry trains them for abroad.
haushalt.posten.bildung.name: Education
haushalt.posten.bildung.wirkung: +1 step: skilled workers rise in about three years; raises the limit up to which research works.
haushalt.posten.einkommensteuer.kehrseit: Payroll deductions hit workers who cannot avoid them; whoever can, moves into the shadow economy.
haushalt.posten.einkommensteuer.name: Income tax
haushalt.posten.einkommensteuer.text: What employees and the self-employed pay on their income.
haushalt.posten.einkommensteuer.wirkung: +1 step: more revenue at once, real wages fall.
haushalt.posten.forschung.kehrseite: Research without skilled people fizzles: above the innovation limit each extra lira achieves little.
haushalt.posten.forschung.name: Research and development
haushalt.posten.forschung.text: Research funding, university labs, state institutes (TÜBİTAK), technology programmes.
haushalt.posten.forschung.wirkung: +1 step: universities and productivity rise in about two years, less emigration.
haushalt.posten.gesundheit.kehrseite: Money does not train doctors: part of it fizzles without training, and waiting times fall only after a year.
haushalt.posten.gesundheit.name: Health
haushalt.posten.gesundheit.wirkung: +1 step: waiting times fall in about a year, life expectancy rises slowly.
haushalt.posten.innere_sicherheit.kehrse: More police lowers crime but can narrow press freedom.
haushalt.posten.innere_sicherheit.name: Internal security
haushalt.posten.innere_sicherheit.text: Police, gendarmerie, border guards, intelligence services.
haushalt.posten.innere_sicherheit.wirkun: +1 step: crime and terror risk fall in about six months.
haushalt.posten.investitionen.kehrseite: The costs hit the budget at once, the returns come only after years; construction drives up prices.
haushalt.posten.investitionen.name: Infrastructure and transport
haushalt.posten.investitionen.text: Roads, rail, bridges, ports, water: works that last decades.
haushalt.posten.investitionen.wirkung: +1 step: construction picks up at once, transport and productivity grow in about eighteen months.
haushalt.posten.kultur.kehrseite: Culture brings prestige and visitors, but rarely votes in a crisis.
haushalt.posten.kultur.name: Culture
haushalt.posten.kultur.text: Museums, monuments, theatres, religious and cultural heritage.
haushalt.posten.kultur.wirkung: +1 step: heritage and tourism gain in about six months.
haushalt.posten.landwirtschaft.kehrseite: Support keeps unprofitable farms alive too.
haushalt.posten.landwirtschaft.name: Agriculture
haushalt.posten.landwirtschaft.text: Farm support, irrigation, advice, crop insurance.
haushalt.posten.landwirtschaft.wirkung: +1 step: rural incomes rise in about a year, less rural flight.
haushalt.posten.personal.kehrseite: Higher state salaries pull private wages up and drive prices.
haushalt.posten.personal.name: Administration and staff
haushalt.posten.personal.text: Public sector salaries and running the administration; the second-largest budget item.
haushalt.posten.personal.wirkung: +1 step: civil servants happier at once, less corruption, more wage pressure.
haushalt.posten.rentenalter.kehrseite: Later retirement relieves the funds only over years and is unpopular at once; the young find it harder to get in.
haushalt.posten.rentenalter.name: Retirement age
haushalt.posten.rentenalter.text: The age at which people retire on average.
haushalt.posten.rentenalter.wirkung: +1 year: saves money, relieves social security in about a year; workers grumble at once.
haushalt.posten.rentenniveau.kehrseite: A higher level is quick to pass and hard to reverse; every year of ageing makes it costlier.
haushalt.posten.rentenniveau.name: Pension level
haushalt.posten.rentenniveau.text: The pension as a share of the average wage; the state covers the social security (SGK) gap.
haushalt.posten.rentenniveau.wirkung: +1 step: pensioners happier at once, old-age poverty falls within months.
haushalt.posten.sozialhilfe.kehrseite: Aid without work pushes some into the shadow economy; whoever cuts later hits the weakest.
haushalt.posten.sozialhilfe.name: Welfare and family
haushalt.posten.sozialhilfe.text: Social assistance, child benefit, help for families and the needy.
haushalt.posten.sozialhilfe.wirkung: +1 step: poverty falls within a few months.
haushalt.posten.subventionen.kehrseite: Suppressed prices do not vanish: they reappear in the budget, and whoever cuts sees the bill at once.
haushalt.posten.subventionen.name: Subsidies and price supports
haushalt.posten.subventionen.text: Cheaper power and diesel, capped prices: the state pays so daily life stays cheaper.
haushalt.posten.subventionen.wirkung: +1 step: energy and food cheaper at once.
haushalt.posten.umwelt_energie.gewinner: City dwellers, young people, energy sector
haushalt.posten.umwelt_energie.kehrseite: Returns come late; until then the budget pays for projects that deliver power only in years.
haushalt.posten.umwelt_energie.name: Environment and energy
haushalt.posten.umwelt_energie.text: Grid expansion, renewables, clean air, climate protection.
haushalt.posten.umwelt_energie.wirkung: +1 step: more renewable power and cleaner air in about two years.
haushalt.posten.unternehmensteuer.kehrse: Higher profit taxes drive capital away; lower ones attract it but cost revenue.
haushalt.posten.unternehmensteuer.name: Corporate tax
haushalt.posten.unternehmensteuer.text: Tax on the profits of corporations.
haushalt.posten.unternehmensteuer.wirkun: +1 step: more revenue, less investment and foreign capital.
haushalt.posten.verbrauchsteuern.kehrsei: Consumption taxes are quick to raise and hit the poorest hardest; they drive prices.
haushalt.posten.verbrauchsteuern.name: VAT and excise taxes
haushalt.posten.verbrauchsteuern.text: Taxes on consumption, fuel, tobacco and cars; together the state's largest source of revenue.
haushalt.posten.verbrauchsteuern.verlier: All consumers, especially the poor and pensioners
haushalt.posten.verbrauchsteuern.wirkung: +1 step: more revenue at once, daily life gets dearer.
haushalt.posten.verteidigung.kehrseite: Arms reassure at home and worry neighbours; new systems take a year or more to reach the troops.
haushalt.posten.verteidigung.name: Defence
haushalt.posten.verteidigung.text: Armed forces, procurement, arms projects, upkeep.
haushalt.posten.verteidigung.wirkung: +1 step: readiness and deterrence rise in about a year.
haushalt.posten.wohnen.kehrseite: State housing competes with private building for workers and materials.
haushalt.posten.wohnen.name: Housing
haushalt.posten.wohnen.text: Social housing (TOKİ), earthquake-proof renovation, rent support.
haushalt.posten.wohnen.wirkung: +1 step: rents fall and homes get safer in about eighteen months.
haushalt.ui.abnehmend: Each further step yields less than the one before.
haushalt.ui.bestaetigung.entwurf_text: Free in the budget window: the change goes into the draft and takes effect when the budget law passes parliament.
haushalt.ui.bestaetigung.nachtrag_text: Supplement outside the window: this costs {kapital} capital (double price) and some legitimacy; the deficit moves from {vorher} to {nachher} % of GDP.
haushalt.ui.bilanz.hinweis: The deficit consists of the budget law baseline ({grund} %), the spending impulse ({impuls} % of GDP, {regler} of it from the sliders), the cost of measures ({massnahmen} %) and extra interest on the debt ({zins} %). More spending drives demand and prices; interest is a fixed item that follows market rates only slowly.
haushalt.ui.bilanz.titel_defizit: The state spends {defizit} % of GDP more than it takes in
haushalt.ui.bilanz.titel_ueberschuss: The state takes in {wert} % of GDP more than it spends
haushalt.ui.bisher.leer: No change to the budget yet.
haushalt.ui.forschung.grenze: Works fully up to a limit of {grenze} % of GDP; education raises the limit. {verpufft} % fizzles out.
haushalt.ui.plan.hinweis: The central government budget law by economic type; the planned deficit is about {defizit} tn lira ({bip} % of GDP).
haushalt.ui.plan.ressorts_beleg: The department budgets are only partly derived from these lines (pensions, infrastructure, staff); the other starting shares are game parameters still to be checked.
haushalt.ui.reifung: Only {anteil} % in effect so far (full after about {monate} months).
haushalt.ui.renten.etat: Pensions in total: {etat} % of GDP ({mrd} bn lira); a little more with every year of ageing.
haushalt.ui.ressorts.hinweis_nachtrag: Move a slider to see the consequences. Outside the October window every change costs {faktor} times the capital (double again in the unpopular direction) and some legitimacy.
haushalt.ui.ressorts.hinweis_offen: Move the sliders: in the budget window every change is free and collects in the draft. More money costs deficit and drives prices; each step above +2 yields less than the one before.
haushalt.ui.zyklus.einbringen_text: The draft ({n} items) goes to parliament as one law; the vote is in {tage} days. Expected yes votes: {erwartet}, needed: {noetig}. If the budget fails, last year's budget continues and the government loses legitimacy.
haushalt.ui.zyklus.entwurf_leer: No change in the draft yet. Set sliders below or adopt a package:
haushalt.ui.zyklus.ergebnis.fortgeschrie: The last budget was rolled over unchanged.
haushalt.ui.zyklus.ergebnis.gescheitert: The last budget failed in parliament; last year's budget continues.
haushalt.ui.zyklus.geschlossen_text: Once a year, in October (four weeks), all sliders are free and go through parliament as one budget law. Outside the window every change is a supplementary budget: {faktor} times the capital cost and a small legitimacy penalty.
haushalt.ui.zyklus.luecke: About {n} votes are missing; as with any law, some can be secured with capital.
haushalt.ui.zyklus.naechstes: Next budget window: October {jahr} · in {monate, plural, one {# month} other {# months}}
haushalt.ui.zyklus.offen: Budget window open · {tage, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} left
haushalt.ui.zyklus.offen_text: Until 28 October you set the sliders for free; the changes collect in the draft and go through parliament as one budget law. Outside the window every change costs double as a supplementary budget, plus some legitimacy.
haushalt.ui.zyklus.parlament: The budget law is in parliament · vote in {tage, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
haushalt.zyklus.hinweis.entwurf: Budget window: free — the change goes into the draft and takes effect with the budget law.
haushalt.zyklus.hinweis.nachtrag: Supplementary budget outside the window: double capital cost and a small legitimacy penalty. Next window: October {jahr}.
haushalt.ui.behoerden.satz: This year the departments have spent on their agencies: {liste, list}.
haushalt.ui.behoerden.posten: {posten} {etat, prozent, 2} of GDP from the extra budget{defizit, select, ja { and {d, prozent, 2} on the deficit} other {}}
haushalt.ui.behoerden.keine: The agencies have not yet spent anything from the departmental budgets this year.
